Definition: from G2181; an Ephesian or inhabitant of Ephesus:--Ephesian, of Ephesus.
BiblicalUsage: Ephesios is an Ephesian, a person of Ephesus. The word rings through the riot: Great is Diana of the Ephesians, the crowd cries for two hours, and Trophimus the Ephesian is the man Paul is accused of bringing into the temple.
TheologicalSignificance: A whole city can be stirred by a threatened idol, and one Ephesian's name could put Paul's life at risk — that is the power of a riot, I believe.
